review_finding: The receipt callback originally preserved empty/owned output checks but omitted frozen artifact_io.check_directory's destination free-space and W_OK admission.
correction: Restore the unchanged >=2GiB destination free-space and os.access(root, os.W_OK) rule in constructor preflight and immediately before artifact.write. Windows uses shutil.disk_usage(root).free; Linux uses statvfs.f_bavail * f_frsize, matching the frozen formula. No thresholds, deadlines, ownership checks or historical sources changed.

qualification.observed_red: Before implementation, both resource-refusal cases reached the mocked artifact writer rather than raising the original resource admission error; the boundary helper was absent. The same focused regression passes after correction.
qualification.scope: Only the new resource regression and the affected actual child/host happy path were rerun. Earlier thirteen profile/artifact checks, core checks and the previous three receipt checks were not repeated.
